title: DMARKOFF articles: data and scripts
description: Data and scripts behind articles on the DMARKOFF blog about SPF and DMARC: a comparison of free SPF checkers against RFC 7208, a test of how mailbox providers handle broken SPF records, and a DNS snapshot of SPF and DMARC across the Tranco top 100,000 domains (October 2026). One folder per article.
references: Le Pochat, V., Van Goethem, T., Tajalizadehkhoob, S., Korczyński, M., & Joosen, W. (2019). Tranco: A Research-Oriented Top Sites Ranking Hardened Against Manipulation. NDSS 2019. https://doi.org/10.14722/ndss.2019.23386
notes: If you use this data, please cite it as below. Each folder's README also gives a citation for its article.
